answer: A grove keeper stakes 70 credits on a grove below a summit beacon, filing its echo. Anyone may re-sound the grove against the summit log; a false echo forfeits the bond, 40% to the challenger. Filing is 40+8(k-1) per identity, so 1,000 fake groves pay 4,036,000, locking 70,000. Any fake can defect and claim bounties on the rest, so the operator must bribe the hush-money ring. An honest keeper files one true echo, pays 40 once, keeps the bond.
